messages:
lina: Quick sync for Helios Systems marketplace listing + HW SKU. T-48h to embargo. Need owners: assets, SI validation, pricing confirmation, legal quote.

chael: Ill run SI validation. Slot tomorrow 10:00 PT. Will need Helios firmware contact on call.

peter: Partner sent hero + thumbnails but filenames inconsistent. I requested canonical names and CDN path s3://helios/marketplace/4499/. Can accept low-res for preview; final must be 2x retina.

anya: I have landing copy draft in /staging/marketplace/helios/. Pushed SEO meta and CTA copy; waiting on hero to finalize above-the-fold.

lina: Embargo is 2026-06-10T17:00:00Z. All public assets and legal signoff required by 2026-06-09T17:00:00Z (T-24h). No exceptions.

chael: SI runbook (short):
```
- checkout release/helios-marketplace
- deploy connector v1.6.0
- run smoke: ./ci/smoke.sh --sku HEL-XL
- run int: ./ci/integrate.sh --partner helios --env staging
- verify handshake: grep "handshake complete" /var/log/redwood/connector.log
- upload screenshots to Partnerships/Helios/tests/
```
If firmware mismatch -> fallback = publish listing with "integration pending" badge and disable deploy button.

peter: CDN path confirmed when assets are normalized: https://cdn.redwood.example/partners/helios/4499/. I asked Helios for the standardized file list.

anya: Legal needs a 1-sentence partner quote. I sent template to Helios marketing; expect reply by tomorrow 12:00 PT.

peter: Added INF-8533 to ensure analytics includes partner.sku and partner.region in event payloads.

deploy-bot: preview-check started (job 12789)
deploy-bot: preview-check succeeded  no broken links detected :white_check_mark:

lina: Two asks to mark launch-ready: 1) @peter confirm final CDN filenames; 2) @chael post SI run results after 10:00 PT run. If no blockers by 13:00 PT tomorrow we call this "launch-ready" and schedule dry-run at 14:00 PT.

chael: Will post run results and screenshots.

peter: Uploaded placeholder hero to CDN path and will replace when Helios sends hi-res.

lina: Thanks team 44d document results in Partnerships/Marketplace/Helios/launch-playbook.md and tag approvals in the tracker.
